data_quality_notes: Gen 9 SV machine numbers follow fetched PokeAPI machine records, corroborated on contested slots (TM106 Drill Run, TM116 Stealth Rock, TM119 Energy Ball) against Serebii/Game8 listings 2026-10-27; the owner-supplied SV list was reconciled separately (227/229 slots match; see INDEX.md).
Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl: PokeAPI machine coverage is partial (17 TM/HM records) — Gen 8 history leans on Sword/Shield records; BDSP numbering is a logged gap, not filled by assumption.
Legends Z-A + Mega Dimension DLC machine records are PokeAPI-only (uncorroborated by an owner-supplied list) and are included as a Gen 9 extension set, flagged per record by version_groups.
Gen 8 TRs (Technical Records) are a distinct machine class: 100 TR records were counted in the fetched data and excluded from this TM/HM registry by scope.

Gen 4 union exceeds per-game counts by design: Defog is an HM only in Diamond/Pearl/Platinum, Whirlpool only in HeartGold/SoulSilver — version_groups on each row record which games carry which machine.
